newsitem.title: UK: SNOOKER-WATTANA FIGHTS BACK AGAINST HENDRY.
newsitem.headline: SNOOKER-WATTANA FIGHTS BACK AGAINST HENDRY.

text.p: James Wattana clawed his way back from 7-3 down against champion Stephen Hendry to end the day level at 8-8 in their best-of-33 world snooker championship semifinal on Friday.
Hendry led 5-3 overnight and put further daylight between himself and his Thai opponent when he won the opening two frames of the afternoon.
His break of 101 in the 10th frame of the match was the 33rd at the tournament.
But Wattana, not renowned for his ability to stage inspired comebacks, won five of the remaining six frames.
His best break was of 82 in the penultimate frame.
